caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic bottle positioned vertically in the center of a plain, light beige background. The bottle has a cylindrical body with a slight curve tapering inward just below its neck, which then flares outward at the rim. The bottom portion of the bottle is a light grayish color, transitioning around the shoulder of the bottle to a mustard yellow-brown color that covers the neck and top. Subtle cracks or lines can be observed on the surface of the bottle, particularly on the lower grayish section. The artist's signature, "RICHARD BARNETT," is visible in the lower right corner. There are no additional objects or designs in the composition.
title: Stoneware Ink Bottle or Catsup Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
